data.one_liner: Animate appearance and disappearance of widgets with pre-built effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedVisibility widget that allows developers to easily animate the appearance and disappearance of widgets using pre-built effects such as fading, scaling, and sliding.
use_when: You need to animate a widget in and out of the UI based on a boolean visibility flag.
You want simple entry and exit animations without writing complex AnimationController logic.
avoid_when: You need complex vector animations like Rive or Lottie.
You are looking for non-visibility related animations like screen page transitions.
strengths: Simple declarative usage with pre-built enter and exit effects.
Combines multiple animations easily (e.g., fadeIn() + scaleIn()).
weaknesses: Limited to visibility appearance and disappearance animations.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive and powerful animation system for a wide variety of visual effects and chained animations.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Better suited for complex vector-based animations exported from After Effects.
